transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get the pre-shutdown huddle started. Before I record the final plan for the weekend work order, I need each of you — facilities, production scheduling, environmental health and safety, and quality — to state any open constraints you have. As you all know, Compressor C-1 is down after a failure, so C-2 is our available backup air source, and the next customer campaign this weekend depends on the compressed-air system. I'll be making the binding maintenance and operating-plan decision based on what we discuss today, so please lay out anything that could affect the plan.

transcript.text: I have an open constraint to share regarding C-1. My failure assessment this morning identified a burned motor winding in Compressor C-1. The good news is there's a replacement motor already in our plant stores, and the maintenance estimate for changing it out is exactly 10 hours. I've confirmed both the parts availability and the estimate this morning, but I haven't yet entered them into the CMMS work order.

transcript.text: I have an open constraint from quality. My latest air-quality sample showed C-2's outlet dew point at -32 degrees Celsius, but the campaign specification requires at most -40 degrees Celsius. Replacing the dryer desiccant takes exactly 3 hours, followed by a dew-point verification before campaign release. I received the laboratory result this afternoon but have not yet uploaded it to the campaign quality record.
